summary: __init__.py files under lib/ansible/modules/, lib/ansible/module_utils/ and test/units/ must be empty.
questions: Why must __init__.py be empty in module_utils?

answer_card.title: empty-init test
answer_card.answer_md: `__init__.py` must be empty in `lib/ansible/modules/`, `lib/ansible/module_utils/` and `test/units/`. Code there isn't used for modules or tests, and empty files keep Python namespace packages possible for module_utils.
